name: lecture-notes-studio
description: Convert lecture PPT/PDF into faithful Obsidian notes with linked exercises, AI walkthroughs, and transferable question-solving methods.

interface.longDescription: Source-faithful knowledge notes with direct Obsidian exercise links, readable overview spacing, and AI walkthroughs and method summaries for classroom problems.
defaultPrompt: 请把我上传的课程 PPT 整理成忠实于原文的 Obsidian 笔记，保留教学图片并生成 ZIP。
请将这份 PDF 课件按知识模块整理成完整笔记和知识点速览，不添加课外知识。
请检查这份课件笔记是否遗漏知识点、原始图片或页码来源。
